reviews.sourceExplanation:
F₁ = F₂ = P. The angle between F₁ and F₂ is θ and the angle between resultant and force is α.
From triangle ACD: AC² = AD² + CD².
R² = (P + P cos θ)² + (P sin θ)².
R² = [P² + P² cos² θ + 2P² cos θ] + P² sin² θ.
= P² + 2P² cos θ + P²(sin² θ + cos² θ).
= P² + 2P² cos θ + P², since sin² θ + cos² θ = 1.
= 2P² + 2P² cos θ = 2P²(1 + cos θ).
Using cos θ = 2cos²(θ/2) − 1:
= 2P²[1 + 2cos²(θ/2) − 1] = 4P²cos²(θ/2).
R = √[4P²cos²(θ/2)] = 2P cos(θ/2).
tan α = CD/(AE + ED) = P sin θ/(P + P cos θ) = sin θ/(1 + cos θ).
= [2sin(θ/2)cos(θ/2)]/[1 + 2cos²(θ/2) − 1], since sin θ = 2sin(θ/2)cos(θ/2).
= sin(θ/2)/cos(θ/2).
tan α = tan(θ/2); α = θ/2.
